reason: Pre-merge consumer review found that fetching overview during search could expose unrelated most-recent accounts when filtered paging fails. This is a possible regression against previously masked fallback, so preserve masking while displaying pending deletion recovery.
fix: When searching, retain members:[] and members_total:0 but pass nextAccess.pending_deletions to Retry Completion; server-filtered account pages remain authoritative.
acceptance: Search still loads protected overview for pending deletion retries
Search paging failure does not fall back to unfiltered overview users
